title: JAXBench：TPU内核自动优化基准测试
summary: JAXBench是首个针对Google Cloud TPU的AI生成内核优化基准测试套件，包含50个JAX工作负载，涵盖生产级ML算子。评估表明，针对特定目标文档的上下文比模型规模更重要，结合搜索结构可达到1.36倍加速比。
summary_en: JAXBench is the first benchmark suite for AI-generated kernel optimization on Google Cloud TPUs, comprising 50 JAX workloads. Evaluation shows target-specific context matters more than model scale, and search structure yields 1.36x geomean speedup.
